Name: Map Image Export (ABANDONED)
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[color=Red][b][size=5]This mod is no longer maintained and may not work in newer game versions.[/size][/b][/color]
There's now an equivalent feature in the base game. Just scroll to the bottom of the in-game options menu and click the screenshot button.


[s]This mod allows you to export an image of any game location into a PNG.

From the SMAPI console, type 'export help'. This will give you the commands and settings available.

The resulting images are stored in 'MapExports/MAP_NAME.png'.[/s]

Manifest.Name: Map Image Exporter
Manifest.Description: Export a map to an image.
Manifest.Author: spacechase0
